title: Logspace in one-sided probabilistic logspace
statement: Every language decidable by a deterministic Turing machine using logarithmic space is decidable by a probabilistic Turing machine using logarithmic space that accepts each member with probability at least $2/3$ and rejects each nonmember on every computation branch.
